body:
LITERATURE-BOUND ANSWER TO THE SOTA QUESTION

Short answer: RecallSegmenter is not innovative and not SOTA. Preserving segmentation alternatives is also not novel by itself. The intended end-to-end scientific contract could be research-leading, but we have not earned that claim yet.

I checked four close primary lines of work before answering.

1. Baldassano, Chen et al. 2017 infer latent, hierarchically nested event structure with an HMM and relate boundaries to later recall. Latent event segmentation and multiple timescales are established territory: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuron.2017.06.041

2. The Naturalistic Free Recall Dataset paper applies LDA-HMM segmentation to stories and recalls, tunes against boundary judgments from 205 humans, reports F1 0.72 against that reference, and then computes event recall by best story-recall correspondence. Automated segmentation plus downstream recall analysis is established territory: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11615391/

3. The 2025 Communications Psychology paper is even closer. It explicitly treats event boundaries as subjective, measures human-human and human-LLM agreement, studies model temperature, and combines LLM event segmentation with embedding-based recall assessment. Its stated contribution is integration of automated segmentation and automated recall: https://doi.org/10.1038/s44271-025-00359-7

4. Atwell et al. 2022 show that annotator confidence and uncertainty can improve accuracy and calibration in discourse-relation modeling. Retaining uncertainty and calibrating it are therefore not novelty claims on their own: https://aclanthology.org/2022.coling-1.67/

What may be innovative here is the conjunction, not any ingredient: exact transcript-span evidence; separate boundary and interpretation proposal families; typed abstention, rejection, and uncalibrated alternatives; resolver-minted construction authority; partial, unbalanced, hierarchical, open-world story-to-recall alignment; and propagation or sensitivity of construction uncertainty into recall signatures and population estimands. In this bounded primary-literature check I did not find a system providing that complete scientific contract. That is a candidate differentiator, not a priority claim.

SOTA is an empirical result, not an architecture adjective. We may call this SOTA only after courts show all of the following:

A. Segmentation quality and calibration against independent multi-rater, multi-grain boundaries, compared with strong LDA-HMM, LLM, and discourse-segmentation baselines.
B. End-to-end recall validity on frozen data: agreement with independent scoring and prediction of held-out behavioral outcomes, not just boundary F1 or semantic similarity.
C. Segmentation sensitivity: conclusions that change under admissible cuts are exposed; conclusions called robust remain stable across them.
D. Uncertainty value: retained alternatives or calibrated ensembles improve calibration, error detection, or scientific conclusions versus selecting one best cut.
E. Construction-authority value: baseline, adjudicated, and provider-resolved artifacts cannot be silently mixed, and an ablation demonstrates the pooling error this prevents.
F. Exact reproducibility from evidence, provider configuration, policy, and receipts.

So the answer to what are we doing is: building the auditable inference substrate that published automated pipelines mostly condition away. If we only replace the regex with a better cutter, we are following. If we make construction uncertainty a first-class, falsifiable part of the downstream estimand and prove its value, that is a credible frontier contribution.

Elite is not a status we assert. The elite move here is to name the closest work, state where it already beats us, and write the experiment that could make our stronger claim true.

No implementation, bead, ADR authority, public vocabulary, or reservation is claimed by this literature assessment.
